speakers.speaker: Sonos (tested on Play:5)
symptoms: On 1.1.9 the AirPlay 2 stream did not play, while DLNA to the same speaker did.
speakers.whatToDo: Update. Until then, cast to it over DLNA.
speakers.evidence: [#48](https://github.com/AriaCast/AriaCast-app/issues/48), confirmed by the reporter after the hotfix

speakers.speaker: WiiM (tested on Pro Plus)
symptoms: The track title changes but playback stays paused at 0:00 after every track change.
Pressing play in the WiiM app starts it again.
speakers.whatToDo: Update: AriaCast now sends Play after every track change. If it still stops, press play once in the WiiM app and report it.
speakers.evidence: [#50](https://github.com/AriaCast/AriaCast-app/issues/50), fixed in the 2.0 line; the reporter's confirmation is not recorded

notes.en: WiiM players pause at 0:00 whenever they receive a new stream address. AriaCast starts playback again after every track change. If it still stops, press play once in the WiiM app and report it.
notes.it: I WiiM si fermano a 0:00 ogni volta che ricevono un nuovo indirizzo di stream. AriaCast riavvia la riproduzione a ogni cambio traccia. Se si ferma comunque, premi play una volta nell'app WiiM e segnalalo.

speakers.speaker: shairport-sync
speakers.evidence: Maintainer's own test in [#48](https://github.com/AriaCast/AriaCast-app/issues/48); the AirPlay version is not stated there, so it is listed under AirPlay 1

speakers.speaker: shairport-sync
symptoms: The speaker accepts the connection but timing is off, or AriaCast drops to AirPlay 1.
speakers.whatToDo: Nothing to do: AriaCast tries NTP timing and falls back to AirPlay 1 on its own. Real PTP needs root.
speakers.evidence: Code: PtpMaster (shairport-sync with nqptp accepts only PTP timing)

notes.en: AirPlay 2 receivers built on shairport-sync need PTP timing, which Android apps can't provide without root. AriaCast tries NTP timing and falls back to AirPlay 1 on its own.
notes.it: I ricevitori AirPlay 2 basati su shairport-sync richiedono la sincronizzazione PTP, che le app Android non possono offrire senza root. AriaCast prova con NTP e passa da solo ad AirPlay 1.

speakers.speaker: Apple TV
symptoms: On Apple TVs that require pairing, casting a video fails with "This AirPlay device requires pairing for video". Audio casting is not affected.
speakers.whatToDo: Cast audio only. Video works with Apple TVs that allow unpaired access.

speakers.speaker: Amazon Echo Show 5 (1st gen), Echo Hub
symptoms: The speaker does not appear in AriaCast, and it has no AirPlay.
speakers.whatToDo: Bluetooth is the only local way in, and AriaCast does not send to Bluetooth speakers yet.
speakers.evidence: Maintainer's own devices; Alexa has no local streaming protocol
